note: D-104: the man in the suit. The host picks one living player every interval_s (random in the range, first after first_delay_s); only that player's game shows him. He stands distance_m away with a clear line of sight, watches for show_s, slips to a new spot every relocate_s while he's out of view, and vanishes (static crackle) when the player comes within near_vanish_m.
